Polished Map

JD Reigrut

2026-09-08

Satelite Basemap

# Bounding box of Biscayne Bay
bb_bbox <- st_bbox(c(
  xmin = -80.46, 
  ymin = 25.30,  
  xmax = -80.00, 
  ymax = 25.75   
), crs = st_crs(4326))

bb_poly <- st_as_sfc(bb_bbox)

basemap <- get_tiles(bb_poly, provider = "Esri.WorldImagery", zoom = 11)

Biscayne Bay National Park Polygon

bb_np <- st_read(here("data", "raw", "key_biscayne_np", "BISC_boundary.shp"))
## Reading layer `BISC_boundary' from data source 
##   `/Users/jcvd/GitHub/waves/data/raw/key_biscayne_np/BISC_boundary.shp' 
##   using driver `ESRI Shapefile'
## Simple feature collection with 1 feature and 10 fields
## Geometry type: POLYGON
## Dimension:     XY
## Bounding box:  xmin: -80.3472 ymin: 25.29143 xmax: -80.08941 ymax: 25.67111
## Geodetic CRS:  North_American_Datum_1983
bb_np_crop <- bb_np %>% 
  st_transform(st_crs(bb_bbox)) %>% 
  st_make_valid() %>% 
  st_crop(bb_bbox)
## Warning: attribute variables are assumed to be spatially constant throughout
## all geometries
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = bb_np, color = "pink", fill = "pink") +
  theme_minimal()

Vessle Tracking Heatmap

sent <- read_rds(file = here("data/processed/miami_dade_vessel_detections.rds"))

res <- 0.002 # In degrees

sent_grid <- sent |> 
  mutate(lon = (floor(lon / res) * res) + (res / 2),
         lat = (floor(lat / res) * res) + (res / 2)) |> 
  count(lon, lat)

sent_clean <- sent_grid %>%
  filter(n >=2)

ggplot(sent_clean, aes(x = lon, y = lat, fill = n)) + 
  geom_tile() + 
 scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "inferno", direction = -1,  trans = "log10") +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_bw()

Seagrass Map (marine megafauna)

seagrass <- st_read(here("data", "raw", "Seagrass_Habitat_in_Florida", "Seagrass_Habitat_in_Florida.shp"))

# Filtering the data to only include continuous seagrass polygons within the Biscayne Bay bounding box
seagrass_filt <- seagrass %>%
  filter(
    SEAGRASS == "Continuous"
  )

seagrass_crop <- seagrass %>% 
  filter(SEAGRASS == "Continuous") %>% 
  st_transform(st_crs(bb_bbox)) %>% 
  st_make_valid() %>% 
  st_crop(bb_bbox)

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = seagrass_crop, color = "darkolivegreen", fill = "darkolivegreen") +
  theme_minimal()

Coral Reef map

coral <- st_read(
  dsn = here("data", "raw", "UnifiedReefMap_v2_2", "commondata", "fwc_unifiedfloridareefmap_v2_2.gdb"), 
  layer = "UnifiedReefMap")
## Reading layer `UnifiedReefMap' from data source 
##   `/Users/jcvd/GitHub/waves/data/raw/UnifiedReefMap_v2_2/commondata/fwc_unifiedfloridareefmap_v2_2.gdb' 
##   using driver `OpenFileGDB'
## Warning in CPL_read_ogr(dsn, layer, query, as.character(options), quiet, : GDAL
## Message 1: organizePolygons() received a polygon with more than 100 parts. The
## processing may be really slow.  You can skip the processing by setting
## METHOD=SKIP, or only make it analyze counter-clock wise parts by setting
## METHOD=ONLY_CCW if you can assume that the outline of holes is counter-clock
## wise defined
## Simple feature collection with 54070 features and 19 fields
## Geometry type: MULTIPOLYGON
## Dimension:     XY
## Bounding box:  xmin: 483271.3 ymin: 46657.94 xmax: 798316.3 ymax: 368350.4
## Projected CRS: NAD_1983_Albers
coral_crop <- coral %>% 
 filter(ClassLv1 %in% c("Aggregate Reef", "Individual or Aggregated Patch Reef")) %>%
  st_transform(st_crs(bb_bbox)) %>% 
  st_make_valid() %>% 
  st_crop(bb_bbox)
## Warning: attribute variables are assumed to be spatially constant throughout
## all geometries
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = coral_crop, color = "green", fill = "green") +
  theme_minimal()

Map with all spatial layers

you_are_here <- data.frame(
  lon = -80.1627,
  lat = 25.7326,
  label = "You Are Here!"
)

you_are_here_sf <- st_as_sf(
  you_are_here,
  coords = c("lon", "lat"),
  crs = 4326
)

legend_dummy <- data.frame(
  lon = NA_real_,
  lat = NA_real_,
  feature = factor(
    c("Boat Traffic (>2 boats)", "Biscayne Bay National Park", "Coral Habitat"),
    levels = c("Boat Traffic (>2 boats)", "Biscayne Bay National Park", "Coral Habitat")
  )
)

map <- ggplot() +
  
  ## Satellite basemap
  layer_spatial(basemap) +
  
  ## Vessel Tracking 
  geom_tile(
    data = sent_clean, 
    aes(x = lon, y = lat),
    fill = "#fc8de6",
    alpha = 0.75,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  
  ## Coral habitat
  geom_sf(
    data = coral_crop,
    fill = "#00E5FF",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  
  ## Biscayne Bay NP
  geom_sf(
    data = bb_np_crop,
    fill = "#FFD600",
    alpha = 0.2,
    color = "#FFD600",
    linewidth = 2,
    linetype = "dashed",
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) + 

  ## Dummy layer generating the clean legend keys
  geom_tile(
    data = legend_dummy,
    aes(x = lon, y = lat, fill = feature)
  ) +

  ## Legend Scale
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c(
      "Boat Traffic (>2 boats)" = "#fc8de6",
      "Biscayne Bay National Park" = "#FFD600",
      "Coral Habitat" = "#00E5FF"
    ),
    guide = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(
        fill = c("#fc8de6", alpha("#FFD600", 0.2), "#00E5FF"),
        color = c(NA, "#FFD600", "#00E5FF"),
        linetype = c("blank", "dashed", "solid"),
        linewidth = c(0, 2.0, 1.2),
        alpha = c(0.75, 1, 1)
      )
    )
  ) +

  ## You are here marker
  geom_sf(
    data = you_are_here_sf,
    shape = 8,
    size = 14,
    color = "white",
    stroke = 3,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  
  geom_sf(
    data = you_are_here_sf,
    shape = 8,
    size = 14,
    color = "#FFD600",
    stroke = 1.5,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  
  ## Label marker
  geom_label_repel(
    data = you_are_here,
    aes(x = lon, y = lat, label = label),
    nudge_x = -0.06,
    nudge_y = 0.01,
    hjust = 1,
    direction = "x",
    point.padding = 0.5,
    box.padding = 1,
    fontface = "bold",
    family = "serif",
    size = 14,
    fill = "#FFD600",
    color = "black",
    label.r = unit(0.5, "lines"),
    label.size = 1,
    segment.colour = "#FFD600",
    segment.linewidth = 3
  ) + 

  coord_sf(
    xlim = c(bb_bbox["xmin"], bb_bbox["xmax"]),
    ylim = c(bb_bbox["ymin"], bb_bbox["ymax"]),
    crs = st_crs(4326),
    expand = FALSE
  ) +
  
  annotation_scale(
    location = "bl", 
    width_hint = 0.15, 
    height = unit(2, "cm"),
    text_col = "white",
    text_family = "serif",
    text_cex = 3
  ) +
    
  annotation_north_arrow(
    location = "tl", 
    which_north = "true",
    height = unit(6, "cm"),
    width = unit(6, "cm"),
    style = north_arrow_fancy_orienteering(
      line_col = "white", 
      fill = c("white", "grey30"),
      text_col = "white"
    )
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "Exploring Biscayne Bay!",
    subtitle = "Where do boats go?",
    caption = "Basemap: Esri World Imagery (2026)\n
    Biscayne Bay National Park Boundary: National Park Service (2026)\n
    Coral Habitat Locations: Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission (2026)\n
    Vessel Traffic Data: Global Fishing Watch (2026) and Human-Ocean Systems Lab (2026)\n",
    x = "Longitude", 
    y = "Latitude"
  ) +
    
  theme_minimal(base_size = 32, base_family = "serif") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 64, family = "serif", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(face = "bold", size = 42, family = "serif", hjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.margin = margin(t = 4, r = 0, b = 0, l = 0),
    legend.key.width = unit(6, "cm"),
    legend.key.height = unit(2.5, "cm"),
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 32, family = "serif"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "grey30", size = 32, family = "serif"),
    axis.title = element_text(color = "grey30", size = 32, family = "serif")
  )

)
